page-month.alt: A monthly calendar page: a seven-column grid for October with moon phases and a few events.

page-week.alt: A weekly page: Monday to Sunday in rows, each with the moon, sunrise and sunset, and ruled space.

page-day.alt: A day page built from blocks: date, title and tags, care check-ins, a dotted writing area, action items and the scan strip.

page-tracker.alt: A monthly tracker: a grid of daily boxes for habits.

page-notes.alt: A notes page with a title box and a dotted grid for free writing.

page-title.alt: The title page of the sample book Northlight.

page-undated.alt: An undated day page: the date box is blank and the page says Day 3, so the book can start on any day.

volume-1-cover.alt: The wrap-around cover of volume 1 of 2 of a quarter book, with its own title block and date range.

volume-2-cover.alt: The wrap-around cover of volume 2 of 2 of a quarter book, with its own title block and date range.

cover-month.alt: A wrap-around cover for the sample book Northlight, deep blue with a row of moon phases and the title in cream.

ed-book.alt: The Book view: all 72 pages of the sample book laid out in facing spreads, with a page-number box, a zoom control and a legend button.

ed-spread.alt: The Spread view: two facing pages, an Exchange page and a Reply page, at reading size.

ed-day-view.alt: A day page in view mode: only the page, clean and read-only, with an Edit button at the top right.

ed-day-edit.alt: The day page in edit mode: the palette of blocks on the left, the list of blocks on the page in the middle, and the live page preview on the right.

ed-grid.alt: The page grid: the preview with its rows and columns drawn over it. Blocks such as the moon and sky line span four columns and two rows.

ed-scan.alt: The Scan settings sheet: switches for the send-to strip and the scanning border, and choices for the matrix code position, size and format.

ed-library.alt: The Library: a shelf with the book Northlight, a series of season journals and a series of undated practice books, each with its own title.

ed-series.alt: A series shelf: three season journals that share defaults, shown as covers in order.

ed-library-edit.alt: The Library in edit mode, with controls for titles, series and the books on the shelf.

ed-phone.alt: The editor on a 390 pixel wide phone: the page preview with the block palette in a sheet at the bottom.

ed-phone-book.alt: The Book view on a phone, with the page grid fitted to the width.

ed-versions.alt: The Versions drawer: a history of saved versions on one side, and a comparison on the other that lists what changed and marks the changed blocks on the page.

ex-shift.alt: A day page arranged for a night-shift worker: the work shift, a 24-hour time line with plan over actual and the night shaded from the day's sunrise and sunset, a care check-in and a writing space.

ex-roomy.alt: A day page with roomy rows: four wide action lines, three widely spaced lines for small good things, and a large writing space.
